purpose: Source-traced financial inputs for later FinRobot verification. This file is not coupled to any repository code and does not modify any repo. Fields with usable_as_finrobot_input=false are fail-closed and must not be treated as complete valuation inputs.
disclaimer: 公司定义的自由现金流与自行用经营现金流减资本开支计算的结果不是同一口径。第三方缺失不以接口齐全为估值前提。官方优先。
